steps.title: Privilege gateway
steps.what: The gateway reads the model field of each request and compares it with the key's list.
steps.why: A virtual key should not be able to reach every model its provider offers.

steps.title: Virtual key with an Allowed models setting
steps.what: A virtual key carries an Allowed models list, which is a subset of its provider's model catalog.
steps.why: A virtual key should not be able to reach every model its provider offers.

steps.title: Provider model-list endpoint
steps.what: The provider's model-list endpoint returns the provider's whole catalog, not the key's list, so a model dropdown built from it does not show which ids are allowed.
steps.why: A virtual key should not be able to reach every model its provider offers.
